0.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_JALZAHN_000_000
0.description: Through the power of atma, I shall imbue your relic with such might as it has never known. Lend me the object you wish enhanced, and I shall see the deed done.

1.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_MENU_TITLE
1.description: Select the relic you wish to enhance.

7.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_JALZAHN_000_020
7.description: Where is the relic? Perchance you forgot to bring it?

8.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_SYSTEM_100_020
8.description: To have Jalzahn enhance a relic weapon zenith, you must be in possession of twelve unique varieties of atma.

9.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_SYSTEM_100_025
9.description: Furthermore, please ensure that the relic you wish to enhance is placed in your Armoury Chest or inventory before speaking with Jalzahn.

10.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_JALZAHN_100_030
10.description: I cannot well perform my work until you make room among your mess of possessions.

11.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_JALZAHN_000_030
11.description: If there are any other relics you wish enhanced, bring me twelve unique varieties of atma as before, and I shall see the deed done.

12.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_SYSTEM_000_035
12.description: By participating in certain FATEs while equipped with a relic weapon zenith, you may obtain an atma crystal.

13.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_SYSTEM_000_036
13.description: Once you have obtained twelve unique varieties of atma, you may present them to Jalzahn to have a relic weapon zenith enhanced.

14.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_SYSTEM_100_036
14.description: Paladins must possess both Curtana Zenith and the Holy Shield Zenith.

15.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_SYSTEM_000_037
15.description: This information can be reviewed in the completed journal for the quest “Up in Arms,” which can be found under “Weapon Enhancement Sidequests.”

16.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_JALZAHN_000_040
16.description: How fare your efforts at procuring atma? Once you have twelve pieces in your possession, bring them hither, and I shall infuse their power into a relic of your choosing.

17.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_JALZAHN_000_050
17.description: Ah, twelve unique varieties of atma! You have done well, my dear adventurer.

18.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_JALZAHN_000_051
18.description: Pray leave the rest to me. I require but a moment.

19.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_JALZAHN_000_056
19.description: ...It is done! True to my theory, the souls housed within the atma have merged with your relic! Take it up once more, adventurer, and savor the newfound power that courses through it!

20.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_JALZAHN_000_057
20.description: ...It is done! True to my theory, the souls housed within the atma have merged with your blade and shield! Take them up once more, adventurer, and savor the newfound power that courses through them!

22.name: TEXT_CMNDEFRELICWEAPON020TRADE_00165_SYSTEM_000_060
22.description: If you wish to have another relic weapon zenith enhanced, you may do so by repeating the process of obtaining twelve unique pieces of atma, and then presenting the objects to Jalzahn.
